results.evidence: tests/test_time_cost_failures.py installs a BEFORE INSERT trigger that raises on activities. It covers log-time and log-cost as new entries, and --voids on a log-time entry and on a log-cost entry. Each case asserts exit 1 (EXIT_REFUSED), stderr starting 'error: could not save the entry', no 'Traceback', and an unchanged activity count. On the unmodified worktree, 7 passed. I copied the tree to $TMPDIR and removed the `except sqlite3.Error ... could not save the entry` branch from cottonwood/cli.py (_run_entry, around line 697). I ran the tests with PYTHONPATH pointing at the copy; the traceback shows cottonwood/events.py:295 raising the IntegrityError from inside the copy, so the mutant was the code under test. 4 tests failed: new-entry log-time and log-cost, and void log-time and log-cost. The 3 blank-actor tests still passed, as expected, since they are not part of this AC.
